component.name: Markdown Viewer
component.summary: Fast, lightweight markdown viewer for Linux

description.p: A fast, lightweight markdown viewer built with Rust and egui. Designed for distraction-free reading with excellent typography, syntax highlighting and LaTeX math, from quick notes to scientific papers.

ul.li: GitHub Flavored Markdown: tables, task lists, footnotes and emoji shortcodes
LaTeX math, inline and display, rendered via typst and mitex
Syntax highlighting for 200+ languages and native Mermaid diagrams
Tables that fill the pane and re-fit as the window or sidebars change size
YAML frontmatter shown as a key/value table; images and SVG, click to enlarge
Right-to-left text: Arabic and Hebrew blocks are right-aligned and mixed lines read in order
Tabs, in-document search, a file explorer and an outline sidebar
Dark and light themes, zoom, full-width or reading-width layout, font and colour choices
Edit mode with save, and live reload on file changes
Session persistence and a welcome page with recent files
Native X11 and Wayland support; Windows and macOS builds are also available

screenshot.caption: Dark mode with mermaid diagram, file explorer, and outline
LaTeX math rendered inline via typst
Tables with inline code and hyperlinks

description.p: Better right-to-left layout and a math fix.

ul.li: Inline formulas in Hebrew and Arabic paragraphs, headings and list items sit in their place in right-to-left text
Right-to-left task lists put the checkbox and marker on the right
The columns of a cases environment are spaced as in LaTeX
Recent Folders dims folders that no longer exist

description.p: Close Folder and a folder history, and fixes for math formulas and tables.

ul.li: File → Close Folder, and a Recent Folders list in the empty file explorer
Recent files and folders can be removed one by one or cleared
Formulas that use less common LaTeX commands render instead of showing an error box
Table columns no longer narrow slightly a moment after a table appears

description.p: Privacy controls for remote images, and fixes for large folder trees and large documents.

ul.li: View → Remote Images: load remote images automatically, ask per document, or block them
Expand All on a large folder tree no longer freezes the window
The file explorer stays responsive on large folder trees
Jumping to a heading near the end of a large document shows the heading

description.p: Fixes for starting without fonts, jumping in large documents, and two install channels.

ul.li: md-viewer starts on a system where no fonts are installed instead of aborting
Jumping to a heading far down a large document no longer freezes the window
The snap appears in the desktop's app launcher
The AUR md-viewer-bin package builds when upgrading from an older version

description.p: The snap starts again in X11 sessions, and two rendering fixes.

ul.li: The snap no longer fails to start in X11 sessions with a missing libXcursor error
Text in SVG images renders when the system's default sans-serif or serif font is not installed
The code-block copy button sits in the block's corner again in Full Width

description.p: Full Width content stays clear of the scrollbar, and large documents open sooner.

ul.li: In Full Width mode, code blocks, tables and long lines no longer run under the scrollbar
Double-clicking the title bar maximizes and restores the window on GNOME
Large documents are parsed once instead of four times, so they open sooner and use less memory
Startup no longer scans every installed font; the scan runs when the font dialog first opens

description.p: Large documents open much faster, and several interface bugs are fixed.

ul.li: Large, code-heavy and table-heavy documents show their first screen several times sooner
Interface symbols no longer show as boxes on systems without symbol fonts
Mermaid diagrams follow the dark theme
The code-block copy button's frame fits its icon and is clickable everywhere
Edit mode scrolls while drag-selecting, and a scrollbar click keeps the selection

description.p: Refreshed store and software-center descriptions. No change to the app.

ul.li: The copy button on code blocks shows its icon again instead of an empty box
Table rows that mix text and inline math are no longer much taller than their content
Short inline code in narrow table columns is no longer split mid-word
Arabic and Hebrew paragraphs, headings, list items and table cells are right-aligned
Lines that mix right-to-left and left-to-right text are shown in reading order
Arabic letters join and Devanagari conjuncts form
Thai text renders instead of empty boxes, and Hebrew uses a proportional font instead of a monospace one
With Full Width off, text after a display formula wraps at the reading column again
Long documents with formulas scroll all the way to their last line
With Full Width off, the reading column is centered and lists and headings wrap at its edge
The scrollbar is always shown, so the column no longer shifts at the scroll edges
The tab bar can be hidden from the View menu; Ctrl+E switches between Preview and Edit
Plain email addresses become clickable links
Links inside headings are drawn inline at heading size, and bare URLs in headings are linked
Emoji followed by the text-presentation selector stay monochrome
Bare URLs written without link syntax are clickable, as on GitHub
The red heart emoji renders in color
Emoji render in full color from the system's Noto Color Emoji font
A Preview / Edit toggle turns a tab into a plain Markdown editor, saved with Ctrl+S
Tables fill the pane, and Full Width is the default
A window on a hidden Wayland workspace no longer freezes when its file changes
One Fonts menu with presets, text sizes and a family picker
Font presets resolve against the fonts installed on the system
Wide tables no longer slide under the sidebar
Choose the document font from every installed system font
Links with a #fragment land on the heading they name
List markers line up with their item text
Copy a link's address from its context menu
Dense tables take much less vertical space
Links to missing or undecodable targets are reported instead of ignored
Viewport-clipped rendering restored for long documents
Table columns sized from content, long cell text wraps instead of scrolling away
Tables follow the Full Width setting together with prose
YAML frontmatter renders as a key/value table
Formula size adjustable independently of UI zoom
Selection highlight and link colors customizable
Font fallback discovered from the platform instead of hardcoded family names
Local Markdown references, including bare and percent-encoded paths, open in the viewer
Cross-platform prebuilt binaries (Linux, macOS Intel/arm64, Windows)
One-line installer script for Linux and macOS
SHA256 checksums on every release artifact
AUR package now auto-published from CI
Flatpak manifest ready for Flathub submission
